commits.subject: Retry executor discovery V2 failures with backoff (#62679)
commits.reason: Coalesce repeated executor discovery failures per context. A lookup after the cooldown can recover inventory when a server is healthy again. Cancellation leaves another caller free to try, and explicit invalidation can request fresh inventory immediately.
evidence: 2fb728da7d:codex-rs/exec-server/src/capability_discovery_v2_cache.rs keeps the successful response in a per-context OnceCell. Failed loads retain the error and retry deadline with delays from one to thirty seconds. Reads during cooldown reuse the error without extending the deadline. A cancelled load produces neither a result nor a new failure. Lookups make progress on demand without a background retry task.

2fb728da7d:codex-rs/exec-server/src/capability_discovery_v2_cache.rs replaces invalidated entries, clears their cooldown, and carries the forced-rescan flag into retries. Existing readers retain their own entry. The source distinguishes execution context in the existing cache key.

2fb728da7d:codex-rs/core/src/session/executor_discovery.rs uses the actual inventory snapshot change when deciding to refresh the MCP projection. The remote Core tests cover ordinary and forced recovery plus restored MCP availability without another explicit invalidation.
2fb728da7d:codex-rs/exec-server/src/capability_discovery_v2_cache_tests.rs contains independent controls for backoff across reads, queued callers, cancellation, and isolation across contexts.

All four exec-server cache tests passed on pristine upstream 2fb728da7d with source-selected Trust 15698 on macOS arm64. They exercised repeated reads during cooldown, queued callers, cancellation, and per-context invalidation. Native libtest log SHA-256 1c4c2b60f382b56d6fcba548e2fc044a4fb081c0b5688009fdbdc7cd7e4a1ad0.

The three native Core loopback tests also passed on the same pristine checkout and locked graph. Ordinary and forced loads both retried after failure. A recovered inventory refreshed the MCP projection without explicit invalidation. Native libtest log SHA-256 fe7572853edf30d02faf72a5f001b7744871aaa821e5a55840275db7d7ce9af2.
